modpedia.patchouli.entry.introduction.pa: ModPedia is a local mod knowledge assistant for Minecraft modpacks. It does not replace the original mod guides: it scans Patchouli, GuideME, and Modonomicon content already installed in the instance and turns it into searchable Markdown documents.$(br2)The knowledge base is based on local guides and custom documents placed in config/modpedia/knowledge/custom/.

Press K to open the assistant and describe the problem in natural language. Use the in-game display name, mod name, or a description such as ‘this machine’; mod IDs, item IDs, and tags are optional precision hints.$(br2)The AI calls the local search tool first. If recipes, steps, prerequisites, or version details are incomplete, it rewrites the query and searches again.

The settings page lets you choose AI answers or search only. AI mode organizes evidence from the retrieved sources; search-only mode skips model requests and displays complete Markdown paragraphs, heading paths, scores, and source cards.$(br2)Source cards can preview the document and, when available, open the original guide page.

The history page stores local conversations, while settings manage the API and search budget. Press F9 to rescan and rebuild the knowledge base; on startup, new or modified Markdown in custom/ is imported into SQLite.$(br2)When evidence is insufficient, ModPedia lists the missing facts instead of treating a similarly named mod as a certain answer.
